Australia Tightens Visa Rules for International Students

Australia has announced significant changes to its international student visa program, including a crackdown on visa applications. Philip Ruddock, a former immigration minister, has urged a radical fix, suggesting students should 'go back abroad'. The changes are expected to impact a large number of international students seeking to study in Australia. Specific details on the extent of the crackdown and the exact nature of the visa changes were not provided in the coverage.
